name: Egypt
description: Egypt from the pharaohs and the pyramids to Alexander, Rome, Islam, the Mamluks, the Ottomans, the Suez Canal, Nasser and today.

checkpoints.name: The pharaohs
checkpoints.note: Egypt was united around 3100 BCE. The Old Kingdom built the pyramids, and the New Kingdom of Tutankhamun and Ramesses ruled an empire.

checkpoints.name: Greeks and Romans
checkpoints.note: Alexander took Egypt in 332 BCE, and his general's family ruled until Cleopatra. Rome then held it, and Egypt became Christian.

checkpoints.name: Islamic Egypt
checkpoints.note: Arab armies came in 641. The Fatimids founded Cairo, Saladin and the Mamluks ruled, and the Ottomans followed. The Suez Canal opened in 1869.

checkpoints.name: Modern Egypt
checkpoints.note: Britain occupied Egypt in 1882. Independence came in 1922, Nasser's revolution in 1952, peace with Israel in 1979, and the Tahrir uprising in 2011.
